listen_address.description: Network interface address to bind the local sync API and Web UI to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: The TCP port number for the Syncthing local API and Web UI.

ui_enabled.description: Whether to enable the embedded web interface within the Syncthingtray application.

ui_username.description: Username for authenticating access to the Web UI. Leave empty for no authentication.

ui_password.description: Password for authenticating access to the Web UI. Leave empty for no authentication.

tray_show_on_startup.description: Whether to display the application icon in the system tray when the session starts.

tray_minimized_on_startup.description: Whether the Syncthingtray application window should start minimized to the tray.
